# Day-One Playbook Checklist

Use this checklist while running onboarding hunts to ensure each step is documented and actionable.

- [ ] Confirm stack is running (`docker compose ps`).
- [ ] Admin token generated and stored securely.
- [ ] Sample dataset uploaded (name: `____________________`).
- [ ] Hunt executed successfully (run ID: `__________`).
- [ ] Telemetry verified in Observability dashboard.
- [ ] Connector replay performed (Splunk / Elastic / Sentinel).
- [ ] Alert triage notes captured (link: `____________________`).
- [ ] Follow-up actions created (ticket / discussion thread).
- [ ] Feedback logged for UX improvements.
